$comment: ADR-007 §2.3: versioned model registry for the comparative matrix. Only entries with verified:true run; unverified tiers report as skipped-with-reason. cost_per_call_usd is a pre-run budget estimate assuming ~2k prompt + ~3k completion tokens per call (puzzle prose + schema-heavy tool replies), refined by the SDK's reported usage.cost per cell when present. Pricing sourced live from GET /api/v1/models (filter supported_parameters=tools) 2026-09-06; per-M input/output USD noted per entry. Dropping a tier entirely requires recorded evidence (schema-rejection rate, pass frequency), never assumption. Rankings traffic cited from openrouter.ai/rankings 2026-09-05 (adoption signal only, not schema-following quality).

models.notes: Cheap-tier default (extract.ts DEFAULT_MODEL). Pre-existing eval baseline. Pricing $0.15/M in, $0.60/M out. Subset cell (8pz x 3 runs, worst-case 12 calls/pz) ~$0.60.

Frontier-tier default (extract.ts DEFAULT_FRONTIER_MODEL). Pre-existing eval baseline. Pricing $3.00/M in, $15.00/M out; pricing.overrides=true (long-context surcharge exists, prompts here are small). Subset cell ~$14.69.
Cheapest named-vendor input in the catalog ($0.025/M in, $0.20/M out, 400k ctx). Subset cell ~$0.19. Needs a pilot: forced-tool-call schema reliability unproven.
Leaderboard #3 by traffic (12.3T tokens). Pricing $0.08/M in, $0.16/M out, 1M ctx. Subset cell ~$0.18. Needs a pilot: forced-tool-call schema reliability unproven.
Open-weights cheap-tier comparator ($0.08/M in, $0.16/M out, 131k ctx). Subset cell ~$0.18. Needs a pilot: forced-tool-call schema reliability unproven.
Mid-tier lower bracket ($0.125/M in, $1.00/M out, 400k ctx). Tests whether the critic loop saturates below frontier. Subset cell ~$0.94. Needs a pilot.
Mid-tier upper bracket ($1.00/M in, $5.00/M out, 200k ctx). Tests whether the critic loop saturates below frontier. Subset cell ~$4.90. Needs a pilot.
Drop-in frontier comparison: identical pricing to sonnet-4.5 ($3.00/M in, $15.00/M out, 1M ctx, no overrides flag). Subset cell ~$14.69. Needs a pilot.

Leaderboard #5 by traffic (5.56T tokens), 1M ctx, tool support confirmed. Free-tier rate limits apply (~20 req/min, 200/day) — constrains but does not block a subset cell. Needs a pilot: schema-compat + pass frequency unverified.
Leaderboard #8 by traffic (3.65T tokens), 1M ctx, tool support confirmed. Free-tier rate limits apply. Needs a pilot: schema-compat + pass frequency unverified.

Default judge model for the direct-solve baseline (ADR-008). Pricing $0.075/M in, $0.25/M out (promo rate ending 2026-09-09; list $0.15/$0.50 — re-verify), 1.3M ctx, tool support confirmed. Calibration 2026-09-06 (judge-as-grader revision): 4/4 correct judgments on gpt-4o-mini solutions (PZL-0002/0003/0004 accepts with grid-level reasons; PZL-0005 reject localizing the solver's self-contradiction). Baseline subset: mini 6/6 determinate, sonnet 4/6 (2 JudgeUnclear on PZL-0002 — judge variance, solver correct).
Test-only route via ZEBRA_OPENROUTER_BASE_URL_OVERRIDE (stub server); $0 estimate still counts calls. For real local models use the qwen3.8 entry below.

Local model via ZEBRA_LOCAL_BASE_URL. Pilot 2026-09-06: 0/2 single-shot (PZL-0003, PZL-0004), both SchemaViolation — prose instead of the forced tool call, failing fast (~50s each). Small-schema tool probe succeeds, so tool-calling works but does not hold at the full extraction schema's scale. Not viable for this pipeline without mitigations (simplified prompt/schema variant, grammar-enforced output).

Local model via ZEBRA_LOCAL_BASE_URL (LM Studio OpenAI-compatible server). Pilot 2026-09-06: 2/2 MATCH single-shot (PZL-0004 in 94s, PZL-0003 in 859s) — schema-reliable on the full extraction schema, but ~1-14 min/puzzle. Requires ZEBRA_LOCAL_TIMEOUT_MS-scale timeouts (default 10 min). Run: --harness local-single-shot --model qwen/qwen3.8-27b.
